name: Case 2 · Red Light
blurb: The Stacks, night. Every light on Dayo Sanni's street turned green at once. Then he vanished.

lines.text: A junction where every light flips green at once. Brick cars pile into each other. Drivers climb out shaking fists. Nobody is hurt — this time.
"Traffic control says the command came from inside the system. That is Dayo's login. Whoever took him made him log in first."

scenes.title: Where did they take him, and how?

scenes.win_text: Needle goes down between two satellite dishes — but Dayo is already in the convoy below.

scenes.brief: The convoy splits three ways out of the Stacks. Sightline is glowing one route as most likely. Trust it — for now.

scenes.win_text: The rider is a middle-aged man, shaking. Spool holds his debts and his family's address.

scenes.prompt: The driver was coerced. He has a family and a number he has to call.

left.label: Flip him as an informant
left.result: He gives you the Portside dispatcher's name and keeps his job.
left.echo: An informant inside the Kites. It opens Case 3 from the dispatch side.

right.label: Book him
right.result: By the book. Patch approves; the man's family does not.
right.echo: Clean record, closed door. Case 3 starts colder.

hesitate.label: You hesitated
hesitate.result: Processing takes the decision out of your hands at 2am.
hesitate.echo: The squad noticed you froze on a person, not a problem.

scenes.title: They are not asking for ransom
scenes.text: The driver, finally: "No ransom. They are making them BUILD something."
scenes.cliff: At Portside, a third kite drops on a dispatcher's desk.
